data.message: I commit to 18 tons and propose individual opt-ins, not unanimity. Each switch from 10 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). This assumes those catches; intentions aren't binding, and long-run gains aren't guaranteed. All other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher20/02/09/07, please help recruit; anyone may choose 18 even if others choose 10.
